The '''Protorion Polygon''' was a structure seen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] directly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Consisting of five separate spires, they were linked together by a completely transparent [[glassine]] bubble in the center. Within the bubble were three gourmet restaurants and a tourist [[Pedwalk|pedway]]. It was located near the [[Orvum Stadium]].
